device_entry.description: 通过USB总线连接的通用设备或实验仪器接口对象，可执行控制传输、批量传输和中断传输，并管理端点、接口、配置与描述符读取。适合用于与各类USB连接的实验室设备进行底层通信和枚举。
device_entry.description_en: A generic USB-connected device or laboratory instrument interface that supports control, bulk, and interrupt transfers, along with endpoint, interface, configuration, and descriptor management. It is suitable for low-level communication and enumeration of various USB-connected lab devices.

schema.description: 向指定USB端点执行批量写入。
schema.description_en: Perform a bulk write to the specified USB endpoint.

schema.description: 从指定USB端点执行批量读取。
schema.description_en: Perform a bulk read from the specified USB endpoint.

schema.description: 向指定USB端点执行中断写入。
schema.description_en: Perform an interrupt write to the specified USB endpoint.

schema.description: 从指定USB端点执行中断读取。
schema.description_en: Perform an interrupt read from the specified USB endpoint.

schema.description: 通过默认控制通道发送USB控制请求。
schema.description_en: Send a USB control request through the default control pipe.

schema.description: 清除指定USB端点的暂停状态。
schema.description_en: Clear the halt condition on the specified USB endpoint.
Release a previously claimed USB interface.
Reset the state of the specified USB endpoint.
Set the active configuration of the USB device.

schema.description: 设置当前USB接口的备用设置。
schema.description_en: Set the alternate setting of the current USB interface.

schema.description: 读取USB设备的字符串描述符。
schema.description_en: Read a string descriptor from the USB device.

schema.description: 读取USB设备的指定描述符。
schema.description_en: Read a specified descriptor from the USB device.

schema.description: 从指定USB接口分离操作系统内核驱动。
schema.description_en: Detach the operating system kernel driver from the specified USB interface.
